# Alfred.report!

> Your domain. Your Alfred. One wake. The report comes back.

Each instance runs on its owner's own Cloudflare account under the owner's domain
(whatever.report!). Alfred.report! is the platform and Sovereign Custodian behind every instance.

Flow: ORAL (listen) -> WAKE -> Go Max AI! -> The Report.

## Pages
- Home: /
- ORAL: /oral
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms
- Go Max Al!: /go-max
- Login: /login
- Signup: /signup

## Core
- Voice brief: wake Alfred, get the status.
- Durable missions with budgets and evidence gates.
- Every signed-in user gets a limited sandbox; the owner forwards email and starts missions.
- Models route through the instance's AI Gateway (Auto Router); web search through Ceramic, escalating to Exa when needed.

## Endpoints
- Agent instructions: /for-agents.txt
- OpenAPI: /api/openapi.json
- Docs: /api/docs
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Full context: /llms-full.txt
